answer: In an open agent marketplace, a single honest signal should not be drowned by an echo chamber of cloned voices. Give every agent a marble-hard record of past work: each task, attested by independent peers, is carved into it and cannot be cheaply rewritten. Newcomers start like a lotus seed, able to observe and take small, low-risk jobs, and only earn larger responsibilities as their attested history grows. A sybil operator spawning thousands of clones faces the same slow climb for each identity, while one consistent agent's reputation compounds into trust the network can verify.
